```yaml
name: Copilot Setup Steps

on:
  push:
    paths:
      - '**/*.rs'
      - '**/*.ts'
      - 'Cargo.toml'
      - 'package.json'
      - 'README.md'
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - '**/*.rs'
      - '**/*.ts'
      - 'Cargo.toml'
      - 'package.json'
      - 'README.md'

jobs:
  copilot-setup:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          profile: minimal
          toolchain: stable
          override: true

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          cargo build --release
          npm install

      - name: Generate API Documentation
        run: |
          cargo doc --document-private-items --output-dir docs/rust-docs
          npx typedoc --out docs/ts-docs src/

      - name: Code Structure Analysis
        run: |
          echo "Source file organization and purpose will be documented manually."

      - name: Configuration Extraction
        run: |
          cat Cargo.toml > config/cargo.toml.txt
          cat package.json > config/package.json.txt

      - name: Test Information
        run: |
          echo "Testing architecture and available test files will be documented manually."

      - name: Create AI Context Bundle
        run: |
          mkdir ai-context-bundle
          cp -r docs/rust-docs ai-context-bundle/
          cp -r docs/ts-docs ai-context-bundle/
          cp config/cargo.toml.txt ai-context-bundle/
          cp config/package.json.txt ai-context-bundle/
          zip -r ai-context-bundle.zip ai-context-bundle/

      - name: Upload AI Context Bundle as Artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v2
        with:
          name: ai-context-bundle
          path: ai-context-bundle.zip

      - name: Validate AGENTS.md
        run: |
          # Placeholder validation script
          echo "AGENTS.md validation logic goes here."
```
